$comment: Golden corpus for house-rules 40's date-claim check. TWO implementations
must agree with every row: skyne/scripts/check_date_claims.py and
already uses (house-rules 29), for the same reason: the hook has to run
standalone on a machine with only this plugin installed, and skyne is
private, so it cannot be imported across the boundary.
Each side's self-test checks its implementation against these rows AND
checks this file's sha256 against a constant in the code -- editing the
corpus on one side only fails that side, which is what forces both to move.
DO NOT hand-edit without updating BOTH CORPUS_SHA constants in the same
change -- see scripts/build_date_claims_corpus.py in skyne, which refuses
to write unless both implementations already agree on every row.
